title: TradFi and DeFi Are Converging Now | Spiko, Maple, and Pointsville at SmartCon 2025
description:
At SmartCon 2025 Spiko, Maple, and Pointsville share how they're shipping secure, interoperable products, powered by Chainlink, to accelerate the convergence of TradFi and DeFi.

Participants:
• Paul-Adrien Hyppolite, CEO, Spiko
• Joe Flanagan, Co-Founder and Executive Chairman, Maple Finance
• Bryan Bodner, Head of Business & Corporate Development, Pointsville

Moderator:
• Artiona Bogo, Global Head of Solutions Architecture, Chainlink Labs

View the SmartCon 2025 playlist: https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLVP9aGDn-X0R1kuQo8qLPnqlT7ThKQR2s&si=pjTcFXjqEOKuldry

Chainlink is the industry-standard oracle platform bringing the capital markets onchain and powering the majority of decentralized finance (DeFi). The Chainlink stack provides the essential data, interoperability, compliance, and privacy standards needed to power advanced blockchain use cases for institutional tokenized assets, lending, payments, stablecoins, and more. Since inventing decentralized oracle networks, Chainlink has enabled tens of trillions in transaction value and now secures the vast majority of DeFi. 

Many of the world’s largest financial services institutions have also adopted Chainlink’s standards and infrastructure, including Swift, Euroclear, Mastercard, Fidelity International, UBS, S&P Dow Jones Indices, FTSE Russell, WisdomTree, ANZ, and top protocols such as Aave, Lido, GMX and many others. Chainlink leverages a novel fee model where offchain and onchain revenue from enterprise adoption is converted to LINK tokens and stored in a strategic Chainlink Reserve. Learn more at chain.link.

Participants: • Paul-Adrien Hyppolite, CEO, Spiko • Joe Flanagan, Co-Founder and Executive Chairman, Maple Finance • Bryan Bodner, Head of Business & Corporate Development, Pointsville Moderator: • Artiona Bogo, Global Head of Solutions Architecture, Chainlink Labs View the SmartCon 2025 playlist: https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLVP9aGDn-X0R1kuQo8qLPnqlT7ThKQR2s&si=pjTcFXjqEOKuldry Chainlink is the industry-standard oracle platform bringing the capital markets onchain and powering the majority of decentralized finance (DeFi). The Chainlink stack provides the essential data, interoperability, compliance, and privacy standards needed to power advanced blockchain use cases for institutional tokenized assets, lending, payments, stablecoins, and more. Since inventing decentralized oracle networks, Chainlink has enabled tens of trillions in transaction value and now secures the vast majority of DeFi. Many of the world’s largest financial services institutions have also adopted Chainlink’s standards and infrastructure, including Swift, Euroclear, Mastercard, Fidelity International, UBS, S&P Dow Jones Indices, FTSE Russell, WisdomTree, ANZ, and top protocols such as Aave, Lido, GMX and many others. Chainlink leverages a novel fee model where offchain and onchain revenue from enterprise adoption is converted to LINK tokens and stored in a strategic Chainlink Reserve.
